tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search and filter the Firme Românești company directory by name, CAEN activity, county/locality, revenue/profit/employee ranges, and VAT status. Up to 25 results per page with an opaque cursor. Financial filters use a single year (default 2024). Provide at least one filter.

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Fetch a single Romanian company by CUI (accepts an 'RO' prefix): identity, address, CAEN activities, latest public financials, and data-source freshness. Does not return contact details.

tools.name: get_company_financials
tools.description: Yearly financial history for a company by CUI: revenue, profit, employees, total assets and liabilities. Amounts in RON.

tools.name: get_company_status
tools.description: Public status flags for a company by CUI: registration status, VAT (TVA) registration, fiscal activity, insolvency, dissolution (radiere), and e-Factura.

tools.name: resolve_caen
tools.description: Look up a Romanian CAEN (NACE) activity code and return its official label plus hierarchy (section, division, parent). Labels are in Romanian.
